body:
The ocean was absorbing `(1 - α_direct) * SW` ignoring the diffuse SW and leading to substantial warming. The correct term is `(1 - α_direct) * (SW - SW_diffuse) + (1 - α_diffuse) * SW_diffuse`.

**Note:** This change requires adding a new coupler field `SW_d_diffuse` that must be averaged over time when the ocean steps more slowly than the coupler.
title: Reflect diffuse SW
